objective: Complete readable high-level C reimplementation of the firmware, thoroughly compared against original input and output
implementation_constraint: All subsystems must be high-level C; generated instruction translation or runtime ROM execution is not an acceptable final implementation

requirements.scope: Full startup, persistent state, power management, peripheral interactions and emulator callbacks
requirements.implemented_subset: Prepared boot and emulator host bridge, typed persistent variable/result/display state, replay append/eviction/recall and diagnostic contrast UI; main routing/key-wait scheduler and typed UI/menu/screen completion are available; full subordinate lifecycle integration and remaining boot diagnostics are pending

requirements.scope: Keyboard scanning, editing, cursor, menus, history and mode setup
requirements.implemented_subset: Prepared key controllers, editors/cursors, input export/equation normalization, error dialog/key acceptance and editable/cached-result cursor restoration; ordinary input evaluation/variable/Ans/replay commit, cancellation/error/reset/export continuation and linear/natural expression/result presentation. Ordinary outer typing/command dispatch is available; generic menu navigation, MODE/SETUP and MATRIX/VECTOR mode menu controllers are available; their complete scheduler composition and specialized contexts remain pending

requirements.scope: All input token categories, literal bases, precedence, function dispatch, variables, errors and mode constraints
Exact numeric storage, decimal arithmetic, rational and surd arithmetic, rounding, range and error semantics
Trigonometry, inverse functions, exponentials, logarithms, roots, powers and angle-unit conversions
requirements.implemented_subset: Square/cube/nth roots, forward/inverse trigonometry and special-result tables, all six hyperbolic functions, ln/log10/arbitrary-base logarithms, exp/exp10, general real powers and prepared complex coordinates; complete mode UI remains pending

requirements.scope: Numerical integration/differentiation/sums, solving, combinatorics, random functions and complex arithmetic
requirements.implemented_subset: Factorial/permutations/combinations/percent, shared COMP/CMPLX expressions, scalar absolute/conjugation/argument, finite sum/product, adaptive Gauss-Kronrod integral and Richardson derivative expression orchestration with native sample order, cancellation and X restoration. Prepared linear/quadratic/cubic solvers and native degeneracy diagnostics are available; prepared generic SOLVE numerical callback iteration is available; SOLVE expression/history/display orchestration and random functions remain pending

requirements.scope: Statistics, distributions, equation, matrix, vector, table and base-N modes, constants and unit conversions
requirements.implemented_subset: Prepared statistics/regression kernels and table editor/cache/normal distribution kernels; matrix/vector arithmetic, determinant/inverse, REF/RREF, numeric preparation, typed slot storage, prepared rich operand dispatch/allocation and grid/caption/cursor display; equation/inequality result display; BASE-N word conversion, arithmetic/logic, radix literals, stored-scalar preparation and integer formatting; DMS/constant/conversion expression dispatch and BASE-N shared grammar; prepared generic menus, MODE/SETUP and MATRIX/VECTOR dimension/action menu controllers; linear/quadratic/cubic equation kernels and native failure diagnostics. Complete mode grammar/UI and object allocation/editing, equation coefficient/history/display orchestration, table mode and complete menu/scheduler composition remain pending

requirements.scope: All decimal, rational, surd, pi, recurring, sexagesimal, complex and mode-specific output policies
Fonts, pixels, recursive expression layout, editing decorations, clipping and display transfers
Runnable calculator with original expression and key-sequence input/output behavior
requirements.implemented_subset: Supported COMP arithmetic, fractions, square/cube/nth roots, powers, factorial/percent/nPr/nCr, forward/inverse trig and hyperbolic, single/two-argument logarithms and exponentials through records, formatter tokens, layout and LCD; structured display-to-input conversion and error cursor mapping. Prepared editor, cursor and nonblocking host key-wait/controller and annunciator APIs; complete key UI and other mode pipelines remain pending; shared CMPLX expression evaluation and prepared rectangular output composed through natural display tokens and LCD pixels; prepared scalar variable transactions and finite sum/product, integral and derivative expressions now share the evaluator grammar. Prepared input recovery and nonblocking diagnostic lifecycle are available; ordinary input transaction and presentation controllers are available; ordinary outer typing/command dispatch and main scheduling are available; subordinate menus and specialized calculator lifecycle integration remain pending; prepared BASE-N grammar now composes integer formatter tokens and LCD pixels, and DMS/constants/unit conversions share the evaluator. Generic menus and mode/setup/bank controllers are implemented independently, with complete outer scheduler composition still pending

requirements.scope: Differential tests for full public behavior, boundary/error cases and interactions, beyond isolated routine fixtures

completion_gate: All requirements completed and directly verified against original behavior. Passing tests for implemented subsets never implies full completion.
understanding_metric: Unique documented understood instruction addresses / 46094 decoded instructions in the pinned complete.asm listing; conservative lower bound, separate from completion and parity. See the tracked understood_ranges.json ledgers; the pinned listing and supporting semantic models are local prerequisites.
